items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But at that time, there were only a few bands around. Thad and Mel had the band, and then Clark had a band. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah. Especially during that era; they just weren't using them. But I did pretty fair, considering that New York is mean, period. And to have a big band, boy, that's like... I mean, guys was talking, "Man, why don't you get your band?" I said, "Are you crazy? Nowadays you'd like for me to get a big band." What will I pay them? What will I pay them with? That's another thing.
But at that time, there were only a few bands around. Thad and Mel had the band, and then Clark had a band.
